question: Does the live sign-up of Better Stack, Honeycomb, PostHog and New Relic ask for a phone number after the e-mail step?
why: Only a sign-up shows it. Better Stack documents phone numbers as an account setting (up to three, under Account settings); Honeycomb's documentation lists an e-mail or Google choice, an activation link, then team name, role and referral steps; New Relic's Learn site lists create the account, verify the e-mail address, then set a password; PostHog's wizard and provisioning pages create an account from an e-mail address. None states whether the web sign-up asks for a phone number. Third-party recordings of the Better Stack and PostHog onboarding (pageflows.com) list no phone step but do list a card-entry or payment-details step, whose skip path on the free plan is also unverified. An account on each free plan would settle both; Axiom, Plausible and UptimeRobot are settled by first-party statements that registration asks only for an e-mail address (and a name at Plausible).
